title: Implement Automatic HTTPS Redirect
description: This feature matters as it ensures users are always accessing the application securely, and it does this by automatically redirecting HTTP requests to HTTPS. This improves security and helps prevent potential data breaches. By implementing this feature, yantraverse can provide a more secure experience for its users
testCases: Test HTTP request is redirected to HTTPS
Test HTTPS request is not redirected
acceptance: The feature is considered complete when all HTTP requests are successfully redirected to HTTPS, and the application continues to function as expected
reason: This feature is a high-impact improvement that aligns with the framework's focus on security and stability, and it is a common requirement for many production applications
